technology_name: SUPERHYDROPHOBIC-OLEOPHOBIC MEMBRANES FOR MEMBRANE DISTILLATION WITH ENHANCED SCALING, WETTING AND FOULING RESISTANCE AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREOF
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Membranes treat industrial wastewater pool scaling and organic oil wetting poorly, leading to pore degradation and complete salt crossover.
description: Fabrication of a robust dual-layered, triazine-structured covalent organic framework (COF) composite membrane possessing a high contact angle structure against both water and oils to preserve a 100% contaminant rejection margin.
applications: Hypersaline industrial brine processing, petroleum refinery oil-water separator loops, textile dye effluent treatment, and zero-liquid-discharge networks.
